About Acme Freight

Founded in 2014 by two former terminal planners, Acme Freight replaced spreadsheet-driven stowage planning with a real scheduling engine. Our customers are port operators in Europe, West Africa and South East Asia.

We care about correctness over speed of shipping: a mis-planned vessel costs a customer tens of thousands of euros, so we invest heavily in testing and in on-call discipline.
